Golden shafts pierce the cumulus towers, pooling on the market boards below.
Dawn blushes pink across the cloud-sea, soft as spilled rose-water.
The low sun hangs enormous at the horizon, burning amber through the haze.
Mist drifts between the cloud-islands in slow, silent ribbons.
A rainbow arcs clean through the nearest cloud-bank, vivid and trembling.
Lanterns bloom warm gold along the stall-ropes as dusk settles in.
The cloud-sea below glows amber, lit from within like cooling embers.
Cumulus towers catch the afternoon light along every white curved edge.
Sun-shower threads fall slanted and silver, a rainbow shimmering behind them.
Twilight deepens to indigo and the first stars press quietly through.
The full moon lays a silver road across the sleeping cloud-sea.
Sky-koi drift in silhouette across the wide, burning face of the sun.
Sunbeams fan between the cloud-pillars in long, dusty golden corridors.
The horizon sun flattens and reddens, enormous behind the distant cloud-shelf.
Thin mist curls around the floating dock-posts like slow, pale breath.
A double rainbow brackets the eastern cloud-bank, faint on the outer arc.
Dusk lanterns scatter warm reflections across the nearest cloud-tops below.
The amber cloud-sea catches a last streak of copper from the west.
One great cumulus tower blazes white-gold where the sunlight crowns it.
Rain and sun together turn every droplet on the awnings to fire.
The first evening star appears, steady above the fading violet cloud-line.
Moonlight silvers the rolling cloud-sea from edge to quiet edge.
A flock of birds crosses the sun, slow black shapes against the gold.
Soft pink dawn light fills every hollow in the cloud-sea beneath.
The low sun pulls long shadows from the cumulus across the market floor.
